assign.card: AISession: independent review of the cost fix
assign.brief: Review code commit a392e2049 (merge 8c7748978) on michael/dev, which counts each API message once at its largest usage. Read the diff and /framework/ai/AISession/doc/cost-accounting.md. Check it is idempotent (no double count on replay, tail, partial reads), never undercounts (streamed messages whose usage grows, cache tokens, multi-model sessions), and that --recost writes nothing destructive. Read only: do not change code. Write your findings to review.md in your task dir (verdict first, then each finding with file:line and a concrete failing case), commit it, and land your task.

assign.outcome: Approved the cost fix a392e2049 with one bug: a pre-v2 saved state with zero messages skipped the reset and threw on state.seen. Fixed by the parent (reset on version alone), cost tests 3/3, merged as 3e09dcc39.
